title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
summary: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.
reason: TechCrunch reports a non-model product launch: YouTube Music adding AI-content labels. It is a platform/product launch covered by a reputable media report (techcrunch.com), with title, summary, link, and pubDate observed; no official owner model announcement, so group 3 applies.
